parameters.content:
## GridTilt Cluster Registry Refresh (daily)

Commits an updated server/data/clusters.json straight to main, gated by hard validation. Claude proposes a PATCH (changed + new rows only); the gate applies it and aborts on anything suspect.

### One-time setup
1. Map the existing **HTTP Header Auth** credential `Anthropic x-api-key` on *Claude research*.
2. Map the existing **HTTP Header Auth** credential `GitHub PAT` (Authorization: Bearer <PAT>) on all three GitHub nodes.
3. Set your ntfy topic on *Notify* and *Notify abort* (default: gridtilt-cluster-refresh).
4. Repo is hard-coded to aurph/GridTilt on main; change in the URLs if needed.

### Integrity gate (auto, no review needed)
*Parse + validate* ABORTS (no commit, abort ntfy fires) if: a changed row lacks an https source, estimated[] is missing on a change, an operational cluster has 0 rated MW, a linkedDeal does not resolve against interconnection-queue.json, the cluster count shrinks, total planned MW swings >15% in a day, a status moves backward, or >30 rows change at once.

Kill switch: deactivate this workflow in n8n. After a commit, redeploy on Replit to put it live (push != shipped).

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the Anthropic Messages API request (Claude Sonnet + web search).
// We send a condensed roster and ask for a PATCH (changed rows + new rows only),
// never the full 235-row file back. The validate node applies and hard-gates it.
const root = $json.clusters;
const dealIds = $json.dealIds;
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const roster = root.clusters.map((c) => ({
  id: c.id,
  name: c.name,
  operator: c.operator,
  status: c.status,
  state: c.location ? c.location.state : null,
  gridRegion: c.gridRegion,
  gpuCount: c.gpuCount,
  chipType: c.chipType,
  ratedPowerMW: c.ratedPowerMW,
  plannedPowerMW: c.plannedPowerMW,
  energySource: c.energySource,
  workload: c.workload,
  linkedDeal: c.linkedDeal,
  onlineDate: c.onlineDate,
  estimated: c.estimated
}));

const prompt = [
  "You maintain GridTilt's registry of named AI training/inference superclusters (server/data/clusters.json). Today is " + today + ". The registry was last refreshed " + root.lastRefreshed + ".",
  "",
  "Here is the CURRENT roster (condensed; sources/notes/coordinates omitted):",
  JSON.stringify(roster),
  "",
  "Valid linkedDeal ids (nuclear-for-AI deals in interconnection-queue.json). A cluster's linkedDeal must be one of these or null:",
  JSON.stringify(dealIds),
  "",
  "Using web search, find what has CHANGED since " + root.lastRefreshed + ":",
  "1. Status transitions (announced -> construction -> operational) announced by the operator, utilities, or credible trade press (DCD, Data Center Frontier, SemiAnalysis, Tom's Hardware, Reuters, Bloomberg, utility filings).",
  "2. Power figure updates: rated MW newly energized, planned MW revised by the operator.",
  "3. New NAMED superclusters or campuses (including new operators) at 100 MW planned or larger, primarily US.",
  "4. Newly disclosed gpuCount or chipType for existing rows.",
  "",
  "Output ONLY this JSON object, no prose and no markdown fences:",
  '{"updates": [{"id": "<existing id>", "set": {<only the changed fields>}, "estimated": [<full replacement list of field names whose values are estimates or forward targets>], "addSources": ["https://..."]}], "newClusters": [{<full row>}]}',
  "",
  "Rules:",
  "- updates[].set may only contain: name, operator, status, gridRegion, gpuCount, chipType, ratedPowerMW, plannedPowerMW, energySource, workload, linkedDeal, onlineDate, notes. Include ONLY fields that changed.",
  "- Every update MUST include addSources with at least one https URL you actually checked this run, and an explicit estimated array (the row's complete new estimated list, [] if every value is sourced).",
  "- Every newClusters row MUST have every field: id (new kebab-case), name, operator, status, location {city, state, lat, lng}, gridRegion (ERCOT|PJM|WECC|MISO|SERC|SPP|NPCC|CAISO), gpuCount (null when undisclosed, never invented), chipType, ratedPowerMW (0 until energized), plannedPowerMW, energySource, workload, linkedDeal (an id from the list above or null), onlineDate, estimated, sources (1+ https URLs), notes.",
  "- status is exactly one of: announced, construction, operational. Never move a status backward. An operational cluster must have ratedPowerMW > 0.",
  "- Do not invent precision. Any figure that is a target, projection, or your estimate goes in that row's estimated array.",
  "- Never delete, rename, or re-id a cluster. Do not restate rows that did not change.",
  "- If nothing changed, output {\"updates\": [], \"newClusters\": []}."
].join("\n");

const requestBody = {
  model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  max_tokens: 16000,
  tools: [{ type: "web_search_20260209", name: "web_search", max_uses: 15 }],
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }]
};
return [{ json: { requestBody } }];

parameters.body: ={{ 'GridTilt cluster refresh ABORTED, no commit. Reason: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : JSON.stringify($json.error || $json))) }}
